mechanics.name: Immobilize
mechanics.body: Immobilized creatures cannot move and fail any AGI rolls.

mechanics.name: Disarm
mechanics.body: Disarmed creatures cannot make Attack actions, although they can still cast spells but do not gain the benefit of a spell Foci.

mechanics.name: Aqua Charges
mechanics.body: Aqua Charges are gained during Short and Long Rests, and some during the start of combat to empower your Water spells in various ways.

spells.name: Aqua Charges
spells.body: You have a maximum of **Aqua Charges** equal to **4**, which increases by **+1** per 4 Player Levels, and **+1** per 12 Water CA. During Short and Long Rests your Aqua Charges reset to full. At the start of Combat gain 3 Aqua Charges up to your maximum, which increases by **+1** per 24 Water CA.

upgrades.text: At the end of your turn gain **+1** Mana per **3 Aqua Charges** consumed since the end of your last turn.
At the start of your turn gain **+1** Aqua Charge, which increases by **+1** per 36 Water CA.

spells.name: Bubble
spells.body:
As a **Full Action** conjure a large sphere of water entirely engulfing a creature **Medium** or smaller. If the creature fails an **AGI** save, they become **Immobilized** for up to *10 turns* or until you lose **Concentration**. Creatures immobilized this way have **Disadvantage** on AGI **saves** and Disadvantage on all **Attack** and **Spell Attack Rolls**. A creature may use a **Half Action** to attempt escaping the bubble using a **STR** save.

As an **Extra Action** or **Half Action**, you can consume **2 Aqua Charges** to flood their lungs with water, dealing **2d8** Aether damage. Damage increases by **+1d8** per 12 Water CA.

upgrades.text: Bubble can now be used on Large or Huge creatures, however the bubble forms around their head and it cannot Immobilizes them (you can still drown them).
Bubble becomes a Minor Concentration spell.

spells.name: Aquatic Lash
spells.body:
As a **Full Action** make a Melee Spell Attack against an enemy within 6m whipping them with a torrent of water, dealing **1d6** Bludgeoning damage and **1d6** Aether damage on it. Both damages types increase by **+1d6** per 12 Water CA.

If the spell hits, you can consume up to **4 Aqua Charges** to move the creature in any cardinal direction, **2m** per **1 Charge** consumed.

upgrades.text: If you **defeat** and enemy with this spell, drain their body of water gaining **Aqua Charges** depending on their **Size Class**. 1 for Tiny, 2 for Small or Medium, 4 for Large and 6 for Huge, and 12 for Gigantic.
If the attack hits, the creature must make a DEX save or become Disarmed for 1 turn.

spells.name: Rejuvenating Spring
spells.body:
As a **Full Action** target yourself or an ally, giving them a sip of healing water. The target gains **+1d8** Health. The healing Dice *Class* increases by +1 per 24 Water CA.

You may consume any number of **Aqua Charges** to increase the healing Dice *Count* by +1 per 2 Charges consumed this way.

upgrades.text: You may cast this spell as a **Half Action** if you also consume **1 Aqua Charge**. *-1 Mana Cost*.

When this spell is cast on an ally and not yourself, the target gains **2 Mana**, and an additional **+2** Mana per **2 Aqua Charges** consumed (*this Upgrade doesn’t let you consume Aqua Charges, it looks at how many total were consumed with spell from other means*).
